card.name: Words just before health-problem or risk nouns
card.fires_on: Quantity or modifier words such as numerous, other, serious, no and have, right before a noun like problems, risks, effects or hazards. Mostly in talk of health harms and pregnancy risk.

modes.label: Modifier before problems
modes.description: Words like numerous, other or serious that come right before a harm noun such as problems or risks.
modes.example: fleas can cause<< numerous>> other health problems in our pets.

modes.label: Pregnancy background risk
modes.description: The word have in the standard sentence saying all pregnancies have a background risk of birth defect.
modes.example: All pregnancies<< have>> a background risk of birth defect, loss

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like health, safety and security as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a word like health or risk is about to come, after a small word such as other, numerous or have.
